title: Media Archive Lifecycle Management
business: Digital media production companies managing massive libraries of raw video assets.
problem: High storage costs due to keeping infrequently accessed historical footage in high-performance storage tiers.
solution: Azure Blob Storage allows for the organization of massive amounts of object data into containers, utilizing access tiers to move older content to cooler storage and lifecycle policies to automate this transition.
steps: Create a storage account and define containers for raw and processed media assets.
Upload video files into the Hot access tier for immediate post-production access.
Configure a lifecycle management policy to transition blobs to the Archive tier after 90 days of inactivity.
Apply rules to permanently delete blobs older than seven years to maintain compliance and storage efficiency.
outcome: Reduced operational storage overhead by automatically transitioning aged assets to lower-cost tiers without manual intervention.
limitation: Data in the Archive tier is not immediately available for read operations; it requires a rehydration process that can take several hours to complete.
